title: Versioned tag removed from docker.io/bitnami
why: On 2025-09-29 Bitnami moved every versioned tag out of the public docker.io/bitnami catalog into docker.io/bitnamilegacy. A fresh node, a new CI runner or an evicted cache now fails the pull (ImagePullBackOff / manifest unknown).
fix: Pin an image you control: mirror the tag into your own registry, switch to the upstream official image, or license Bitnami Secure Images.

title: Frozen bitnamilegacy image
why: docker.io/bitnamilegacy is an archive: Bitnami states it receives no further updates, so every CVE fixed after the move stays open in this image.
fix: Treat it as a stopgap only: mirror it into your registry today and schedule the move to a maintained image.

title: Helm values pin a removed Bitnami tag
why: image.repository points at bitnami/<app> and image.tag is a version number. Since 2025-09-29 that tag no longer exists under docker.io/bitnami, so the next rollout or node replacement cannot start the pod.
fix: Override image.registry/image.repository with your mirror (or the upstream image) and keep the pinned tag there.

title: Bitnami free tier is latest-only
why: After the change the free docker.io/bitnami images are published for development on the latest tag only. An unpinned or :latest reference in production changes under you with no version pin available.
fix: Pin a version in a registry you control, or use a subscription that gives versioned tags.

title: allowInsecureImages switched on
why: Bitnami charts refuse a non-default image unless global.security.allowInsecureImages is true. Teams flip it to point at bitnamilegacy, which also disables the chart's image verification.
fix: Keep the flag only while the override points at your own verified mirror, and note the image it covers.

title: Digest pin on the old public catalog
why: A digest pin on docker.io/bitnami/<app> was taken from the pre-2025-09-29 catalog. The content moved to bitnamilegacy, so the digest may no longer resolve under the bitnami path.
fix: Re-resolve the digest from your own mirror and pin that registry path instead.

title: Bitnami chart source
why: This file pulls a chart from the Bitnami chart repository. Its default image values point at docker.io/bitnami, so every image the chart starts needs an override review.
fix: List each image.repository the chart sets and override the ones that point at docker.io/bitnami.
